title: Agreement with laboratory physics rests on a physical Church-Turing thesis

statements.text: The framework agrees with standard physical predictions in laboratory situations by construction, provided a physical Church-Turing thesis holds: there is an algorithm that, given a description of an experiment with discrete outcomes, computes the probabilities of its results.

sources.quote: By construction, the predictions of algorithmic idealism agree with those of our physical theories in standard laboratory situations if a suitable physical version of the Church-Turing thesis is true.
